items.summaryZh: NeoMME：高效的多模态原生多语言编码器。我们介绍 NeoMME，一个 260M 和 800M 多语言多模态编码器系列。与许多生成视觉语言模型不同，NeoMME 不使用单独的预训练视觉塔或因果语言模型。

items.title: Playco cut manual fixes 50% prototyping games with GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: Using GPT-6 Astra, Playco built three themed game prototypes from one grey box foundation and reported 50% fewer manual fixes than with the previous model.

items.title: Legora reviewed 41 documents in minutes with GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: Legora used GPT-6 Astra to review 41 documents in minutes, find all four planted errors, and improve performance by nearly 40% in this financial-review workflow.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra: A new generation of intelligence
items.summary: Introducing GPT-6 Astra, our most intelligent and aligned model yet, with state-of-the-art capabilities across computer use, coding, cybersecurity, and science.

items.title: Safety overview: GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: GPT-6 Astra is our most capable broadly deployed model and our first to reach the Critical level of cybersecurity capability under our Preparedness Framework.
